pilot_goal: Test whether materially different prior Mark findings can be carried forward as observation plus relational structure without importing a closed universal ontology.
pilot_pressure_points: Evidence provenance class should be made explicit: frozen result versus post-result synthesis versus diagnostic source.
Discovery quarantine should be distinguished from whether the historical experiment itself was multi-source.
Scale or granularity should become an explicit optional coordinate rather than living only in context text.
Control/null structure is recurrent enough to deserve a structured comparison block in a future schema revision.
Observation censoring/boundary status may need an explicit field if trajectory work expands.
